# Levelrail

> Open source, self-hosted, lightweight deployment platform (the control plane idles at about 200 MB of RAM and 1.5 percent of one CPU on a 2 vCPU box, one Go binary) and a Coolify alternative. Push to git and get a running app with HTTPS, logs, traces, metrics, previews and one-click rollback on your own Linux servers. Single Go binary, Docker runtime, built-in observability, scale to zero. Apache 2.0.

## Start here

- [Docs](https://docs.levelrail.com): hosted documentation
- [Getting started](https://docs.levelrail.com/getting-started): install and first deploy
- [All features](https://docs.levelrail.com/features): every feature by area with a stable, beta or experimental label
- [FAQ](https://docs.levelrail.com/faq): short answers to common questions
- [Feature status](https://docs.levelrail.com/feature-status): what is stable and what is beta
- [Alerts](https://docs.levelrail.com/alerts): notification channels, rules and the alert inbox
- [Kubernetes clusters](https://docs.levelrail.com/kubernetes-clusters): connect existing clusters as deploy targets (experimental)
- [Template catalog](https://docs.levelrail.com/template-catalog): 565 active one-click templates, 346 with a recorded real-engine pass
- [Comparison](https://docs.levelrail.com/comparison): Levelrail against Coolify, Dokploy, CapRover, Dokku and Kamal

## Identity and access

- Sign-in: password, passkeys (WebAuthn), TOTP two-factor, OAuth with 20 providers (Google, GitHub, Microsoft, GitLab and more) and generic OpenID Connect.
- SAML 2.0 single sign-on and SCIM 2.0 provisioning exist but are beta and off by default behind the `saml-scim` feature toggle. [SAML and SCIM](https://docs.levelrail.com/sso-saml)
- Authorization: IAM Allow and Deny policies, roles, teams, scoped API tokens. Audit log with a verifiable hash chain and CSV export. [Identity and access](https://docs.levelrail.com/identity-and-access)
- [Security overview](https://docs.levelrail.com/security): secrets, sessions, node trust, deploy safety, audit log, limitations

## For agents

- [Agent skill](skills/levelrail/SKILL.md): deploy, wait, diagnose and roll back with the CLI or MCP
- [MCP server](https://docs.levelrail.com/mcp): tools, modes and token budget
- [CLI reference](https://docs.levelrail.com/cli-reference)
- CLI on npm: `npx levelrail-cli <command>` or `npm install --global levelrail-cli` ([package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/levelrail-cli)). Client only, never the server (the server uses install.sh on Linux). [Install guide](https://docs.levelrail.com/installing#use-the-cli-from-npm)
- [App spec reference](https://docs.levelrail.com/app-spec-reference)
- [Repo guide](AGENTS.md)
